name: fields
description: A thing's facts as a list of names and values: Status Draft, Due Fri 2 Oct, Project Garden. A value can be words, a link to what it names, or structured text.

use.when: a record's page, or anywhere a few named facts about one thing are read together.
use.not: many things compared side by side, which is a table, or one fact, which is a sentence.
use.with: the record's heading above it; leave out what the heading or chips already say.

label.description: What the fact is, in a person's words.

href.description: Where the value leads, such as the record it names.

markdown.description: Structured text to show instead of value: headings, lists, links.

level.description: The heading level structured text starts at.

prop.description: The field this value is, for the inline editor: data-prop on the value.

source.description: What is stored, when it differs from what reads, for the inline editor.

kind.description: Tells the inline editor to offer a day.

options.description: The choices the inline editor offers, each {value, label}.

a11y.role: list of names and values (a definition list)

keyboard.does: reaches each value that is a link

wcag.notes: A definition list (1.3.1), so a screen reader pairs each value with its name and says how many there are. The names are in words, never an icon alone. Long values wrap rather than overflow (1.4.10).

machine.identify: Each dt is a fact's name and the dd after it its value; [data-prop] on a dd names the field it is.
machine.operate: Read it. A value that links leads to what it names; editing is by the record's Edit, or by asking.
